title: Inside World's Largest Atheist Festival
description:
On October 1st, 2023, Thiruvananthapuram hosted Litmus 23 – the world’s biggest atheist meet, organized by esSENSE Global, a movement that promotes atheism, rationalism, scientific temper, evidence-based medicine, fact-based politics, and humanism.

From its beginnings in 2018 (Thiruvananthapuram) to 2019 (Kozhikode), a pandemic break, and a massive return in 2022 at Kochi with 10,000+ attendees, Litmus has become a global benchmark for atheist gatherings. Even Richard Dawkins and Lawrence Krauss acknowledged Litmus as a one-of-a-kind event.

Litmus 23 featured a packed program:

RB Sreelekha’s opening address as president of esSENSE Global

Talks by Manuja Mythri (Dump Her), James Kureekkattil (Holy Obscenities), and Paulose Thomas (The Tenth Dimension)

Victim testimonies from Prof. TJ Joseph and Abdul Khader Puthiyangadi, who suffered at the hands of religious fanaticism

Debates on Hindutva politics, Neo-liberalism, Uniform Civil Code, and Islam: Alienation and Phobias

The much-loved Geneon evolution Q&A panel with experts including Lucy Malayalam, Dilip Mampallil, Krishnaprasad, and Anand TR from Pale Blue Thoughts

A satirical skit (The Real Kerala Story) by Praveen Ravi

Discussions like Ayushman Bhava featuring Dr. Cyriac Abby Philips (The Liver Doc) and IISER director Kana Suresan on pseudoscience in medicine

Tomy Sebastian’s Gods That Change Clothes and a closing debate with Ravichandran C, Adv. K. Anilkumar, and Adv. Shukoor

Litmus is not just an event. It’s a festival of freethinkers, a call for liberation from dogma, superstition, caste, religion, and ideology, and a celebration of true independence of thought.

👉 If you’ve searched for Litmus 23, esSENSE Global atheist event, world’s biggest atheist meet, Richard Dawkins on Litmus, atheist conference India, Kerala atheist movement — this video gives you the complete curtain raiser.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!
